answer.finalSql: WITH deaths AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', "date") AS month, SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS deaths FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a" GROUP BY 1), cases AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', "date") AS month, SUM("daily_new_cases") AS cases FROM "8fc84d6a-f864-46fe-bd1c-7d7cb897a173" GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(deaths.month, cases.month) AS month, cases.cases, deaths.deaths FROM cases FULL OUTER JOIN deaths USING (month) ORDER BY month
